stem.text: Which organelles are required for the formation of lysosomes containing hydrolytic enzymes?

stem.alt: Three overlapping circles (Venn diagram). Top circle labelled mitochondria; bottom-left circle labelled rough endoplasmic reticulum; bottom-right circle labelled Golgi apparatus. Regions are labelled A (left circle only), B (all three circles), C (right circle only) and D (left and right circles only).
